stem: A technician believes a sensor is wrong and changes its recorded values to match a nearby instrument. What is the primary problem?
choices: Nearby instruments can never be used as references.
Sensor values may only be recorded once per day.
The original evidence was altered instead of preserved and dispositioned through a documented data-quality process.
The technician should have changed the setpoint too.
rationale: The original evidence was altered instead of preserved and dispositioned through a documented data-quality process. This preserves the evidence and role boundary required by the referenced verification framework.
